approval_case.title: Fix a misleading tool result before changing the model
approval_case.situation: The prompt required applied proof, but the tool returned a top-level success label alongside applied false and permission denied. May followed the contradictory label.
approval_case.hao_request: Diagnose why May falsely reported completion and decide what should change first.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Fix the tool contract so failure cannot be labeled success, then replay the original failure and a real success control. Reject a model switch or more prompt text unless the corrected input still produces failures.

human_answer: Fix the tool contract so failure cannot be labeled success, then replay the original failure and a real success control. Reject a model switch or more prompt text unless the corrected input still produces failures.
